sample.title: Why should the ECB care about the unequal effects of climate change?

series.extracted_title: Why should the ECB care about the unequal effects of climate change?
series.text_prefix:
THE ECB BLOG
Why should the ECB care about the unequal effects of climate change?
8 October 2026
By Daniela Arlia and Rachele Rizzo
Climate change and the transition to a carbon-neutral economy do not affect everyone equally. This blog explores how the distributional effects of climate change and the transition can become relevant for price and financial stability.
The consequences of climate change and the transition to a carbon-neutral economy are not the same for all households, sectors and regions. Droughts, for example, can drive up food prices. This hits low-income households harder than others, as they spend a larger share of their income on essentials like food.
